title: [Draft] Add Arabic/English OCR and in-memory authenticated PDF snapshots
body:
## Scope
Follow-up to PR #4 for OCR language/tessdata configuration and source-document correctness.

## Changes
- Add offline OCR configuration through `<app-data>/ocr-settings.txt`:
  - `language=eng`, `language=ara`, or `language=eng+ara`
  - optional `tessdata=/path/to/tessdata`
- Support `SUMATRA_OCR_LANGUAGE`, `SUMATRA_TESSDATA_PREFIX`, and `TESSDATA_PREFIX` environment overrides.
- Discover common Linux tessdata locations and the app-local `tessdata` directory when no explicit path is configured.
- Validate every requested `.traineddata` file before OCR starts; do not silently fall back to English or download models.
- Pass MuPDF's documented `ocr-language` and `ocr-datadir` writer options.
- Snapshot the currently open authenticated PDF into an unencrypted in-memory buffer under the engine's lock hierarchy.
- Include unsaved edits/annotations in that snapshot and use it for both OCR and Flatten workers.
- This avoids reopening the original password-protected file and avoids writing decrypted source bytes to disk.
- Check MuPDF's copy permission for OCR and edit permission for Flatten before creating the snapshot; restricted documents are rejected.
- Important limitation: the new OCR/Flatten output is not re-encrypted with the source password yet. The original protected source is unchanged; re-protect the derived output before sharing it.
- Add `docs/ocr-settings.md` with configuration and privacy behavior.
- Add `docs/manjaro-build.md` with a safe native Manjaro build/test sequence and Tesseract archive inspection commands; it deliberately avoids destructive cleanup or blind `ranlib`.

## Verification
- Dedicated branch based on PR #4.
- CI, unit tests, and runtime OCR have not yet completed.
- No actual Arabic/English traineddata model files were added to the repository.
- The current implementation is file/environment-configured; a graphical language/tessdata picker remains a follow-up UX improvement.

Do not merge until Windows and Linux CI pass and password-protected/unsaved-edit regression tests are added.

## Linux validation added
- The existing Linux daily workflow now runs on branch pushes; PR head commits are therefore validated without duplicating the workflow on both push and pull_request events.
- Added a clean build inside the official `manjarolinux/base` container, with Manjaro keyring initialization, current package refresh, unit tests, and Tesseract archive validation.
- Ubuntu Linux CI also validates the generated Tesseract static archive with `file` and `ar t`.
- This is a Manjaro base-container CI build; the user's local Manjaro/Plasma installation still needs a separate local validation.

title: [Draft] Preserve lifetime reading stats and escape Markdown exports
body:
## Scope
Follow-up to PR #3 for the ReadingStats and NotesExport issues.

## Changes
- Count reading time only for the active GPUI top-level window; background windows no longer add duplicate elapsed time.
- Add a persisted lifetime accumulator for days pruned from the rolling daily history.
- Keep the Total figure cumulative while retaining only the most recent 366 daily buckets.
- Migrate old stats files by folding expired daily buckets into the lifetime accumulator on load.
- Escape CommonMark punctuation in document titles and annotation comments; encode HTML delimiters and collapse line breaks.
- Add regression tests for lifetime-total serialization and hostile Markdown/HTML input.

## Verification
- Dedicated branch based on PR #3's safety follow-up.
- CI and unit tests have not yet completed on this commit.
- The change relies on GPUI's existing `Window::active` state to select the single foreground window.

Do not merge until CI and targeted review pass.

## Linux validation added
- The existing Linux daily workflow now runs on branch pushes; PR head commits are therefore validated without duplicating the workflow on both push and pull_request events.
- Added a clean build inside the official `manjarolinux/base` container, with Manjaro keyring initialization, current package refresh, unit tests, and Tesseract archive validation.
- Ubuntu Linux CI also validates the generated Tesseract static archive with `file` and `ar t`.
- This is a Manjaro base-container CI build; the user's local Manjaro/Plasma installation still needs a separate local validation.

title: [Draft] Finalize and validate OCR/Flatten PDF outputs safely
body:
## Scope
Follow-up to PR #1 on the P0 OCR/Flatten path.

## Changes
- Move `fz_close_document_writer` into the worker's `fz_try` block so trailer/finalization failures are caught before output promotion.
- Validate the completed temporary output by reopening it as a PDF and counting pages before the atomic rename.
- Apply the same output validation to Flatten PDF.
- Use a unique same-directory temporary path for OCR and Flatten instead of fixed suffixes that collide across concurrent runs.
- Catch MuPDF exceptions during OCR writer creation/configuration and clean up the writer/context on failure.

## Verification
- Dedicated branch based on the current PR #1 head.
- No local build or runtime test has been performed.
- CI status must be checked before considering this ready.
- This does not yet solve password-protected or unsaved source-document semantics, nor add Arabic OCR language/tessdata selection.

This PR is intentionally Draft; do not merge until CI and review pass.

title: [Draft] Harden reader stats, notes export, and auto-backup
body:
## Scope
Follow-up safety and build corrections for the reader-modes feature branch. This PR is intentionally based on `feat/reader-modes-mobile-inspired` so it contains only the follow-up fixes.

## Changes
- Keep the AutoBackup ledger source buffer alive while using Split() slices, eliminating the confirmed use-after-free.
- Validate ledger entries against the exact generated basename format; reject traversal and malformed names before path joining or deletion.
- Write backup files, ledger, last-run state, and reading-statistics data through unique temporary files and atomic replacement.
- Commit the new ledger before pruning old backups; prune only validated entries.
- Update the in-memory last-run timestamp only after a successful backup/ledger update.
- Fix ReadingStats parsing of filenames containing spaces by limiting Split() to three fields.
- Fix Str ownership and API/type errors, remove size_t-to-int warning sources, and preserve pending statistics if persistence fails.
- Fix NotesExportCommon Str/TempStr return and ReplaceTemp argument compile errors.
- Carry the fork-specific build-number configuration from the P0 fix branch so the short fork history does not fail before compilation.
- Add regression tests for safe/unsafe AutoBackup ledger names.

## Verification
- Changes were prepared through GitHub Git Data API on a dedicated branch.
- CI has not yet run on this follow-up commit.
- No local Windows or Linux build/runtime test has been performed in this environment.
- This PR does not resolve the separate OCR writer exception/close handling, temp-name collision, PDF output validation, password/unsaved-document semantics, or Arabic OCR selection noted in the earlier review.

Do not merge until CI and targeted review pass.

title: [Draft] Fix P0 menu definitions and command dispatch
body:
## Scope

This draft contains the first isolated P0 correction set on `fix/p0-menu-dispatch-ocr-safety-2026-11-16`.

### Changes
- Split the four File-menu export commands into separate `MenuDef` entries, matching the two-field menu definition structure.
- Add an explicit `break` after each Save As / Save Log As / Searchable PDF / Flatten PDF command handler to prevent unintended fallthrough.

### Verification status
- GitHub source updates were applied to the dedicated fix branch.
- No local Linux build or runtime test has been run in this environment.
- CI status must be evaluated from the checks attached to this PR; absence of checks is not a pass.

### Explicitly not included / still blocking approval
- MuPDF OCR/Flatten document lifetime and cross-thread synchronization.
- Correct PDF document typing for `pdf_bake_document` / `pdf_save_document`.
- Flatten isolation from the open document and failure-path cleanup.
- Arabic OCR language/tessdata selection and atomic output validation.

This PR is intentionally Draft. Do not merge until the remaining P0 items are fixed and the Linux build plus relevant tests pass.
